evidence: Tin(IV) acetate [Sn(OAc)4] was obtained from Alfa Aesar and evaporated from an open glass boat held at 130 °C inside the ALD reactor. Hydrogen sulfide (H2S, Linde, 99.5%) was supplied into the reactor through needle and solenoid valves at a flow rate of 14 sccm. Unless otherwise noted, the films were deposited at 150 °C using 1 s Sn(OAc)4 and 4 s H2S pulses separated by 2 s N2 purges.
